description: The shape of one South Korean statute or enforcement decree without its full text: official English name, version in force, how much is translated into English, its chapters and sections with the article ranges they cover, the linked enforcement decree or parent Act, and how many amendment bills are pending in the National Assembly (a count and a link, not what each bill changes). Works for laws whose English translation is still in progress. Use get_law_article for the text.

law.description: Law slug, e.g. "labor-standards-act" (see list_laws or search_law_articles).
